tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Monad purple. Primary buttons, the logo mark, selected tabs, rank numerals on the podium. Fill only; text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill (4.8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Monad lavender. Soft brand fills: the avatar mark, selected-row tint on `day`, the focus ring on `night`. Text on it is `night`.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Monad's deep night. Fixed in both themes: text on every bright fill (verdict colors, `lavender`, `ice`), the pixels of the eye mark, in-page badge grounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. `night` is the night theme's page; day is lavender-tinted white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, table bodies, cards, the extension popup.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, stat tiles, pixel-tile off cells, input wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders. Decorative only (below 3:1); controls use `line-strong`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and the hash tile frame: at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (14:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, table labels, timestamps on all three surfaces (6:1+).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links and interactive text on the surfaces (5:1+). Brand purple lightened for night, deepened for day.

tokens.name: verdict-ai
tokens.usage: Monad pink. Fill for an AI verdict: badge, chip, the AI share of the consensus meter. Text on it is `night`. Always paired with the word "AI".

tokens.name: verdict-real
tokens.usage: Monad cyan. Fill for a likely-real verdict and the real share of the consensus meter. Text on it is `night`. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: verdict-unsure
tokens.usage: Monad orange. Fill for unsure, split or degraded verdicts. Text on it is `night`.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Monad ice blue. Community fills: the scanner-count segment of a badge, onchain/community highlights. Text on it is `night`.

tokens.name: ai-ink
tokens.usage: AI verdict as text on the surfaces (6:1+).

tokens.name: real-ink
tokens.usage: Likely-real verdict as text on the surfaces (4.8:1+).

tokens.name: unsure-ink
tokens.usage: Unsure verdict as text on the surfaces (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with 2px offset. 14:1 on night grounds, 4.5:1 on day grounds.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: See what the naked eye can't.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stat tiles and podium points; pair with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Detection runs on your device. Only a 64-bit hash and a score reach Monad.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Read from Monad Mainnet · refreshes every minute

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, table headers, stat captions. Always uppercase (text-transform).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tab text, as in Monad's own kit (mono for buttons and links).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Hashes, addresses, transaction ids, verdict badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a badge or chip; pixel-grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; gaps in card grids.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones; page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between sections inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top padding; cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pixel
tokens.usage: Pixel cells of the hash tile and the eye mark; the hash tile frame.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, stat strips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Verdict badges, chips and the consensus meter.

shadow.note: Nadeye separates with borders, not shadows. The one shadow lifts an in-page badge off an arbitrary photo.

tokens.name: shadow-badge
tokens.usage: In-page verdict badges over images only.
